invariants.rationale: By construction, x is computed this way and set via actor.setPosition.
y is computed this way then set as the actor's position.
Width of actorCullingArea is set from actorArea.width when actor instanceof Cullable.
Height of actorCullingArea is set from actorArea.height when actor instanceof Cullable.
If actor is Cullable, setCullingArea was called with actorCullingArea.
